mapper.sql: select medication_id, cat_id, use_date, time_period, drug_name, dosage, administration, executor, adverse_reaction, source_type, diagnosis_id, prescription_id, photos, material_id, material_name, stock_qty, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from cat_medication
mapper.insert: insert into cat_medication ( cat_id, use_date, time_period, drug_name, dosage, administration, executor, adverse_reaction, source_type, diagnosis_id, prescription_id, photos, material_id, material_name, stock_qty, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{catId}, #{useDate}, #{timePeriod}, #{drugName}, #{dosage}, #{administration}, #{executor}, #{adverseReaction}, #{sourceType}, #{diagnosisId}, #{prescriptionId}, #{photos}, #{materialId}, #{materialName}, #{stockQty}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update cat_medication
cat_id = #{catId}, use_date = #{useDate}, time_period = #{timePeriod}, drug_name = #{drugName}, dosage = #{dosage}, administration = #{administration}, executor = #{executor}, adverse_reaction = #{adverseReaction},
photos = #{photos},
material_id = #{materialId}, material_name = #{materialName}, stock_qty = #{stockQty},
material_id = null, material_name = null, stock_qty = null,
remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where medication_id = #{medicationId}
mapper.select: select medication_id, cat_id, use_date, time_period, drug_name, dosage, administration from cat_medication where del_flag = '0' and use_date is not null and use_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and cat_id in #{catId} order by cat_id, use_date desc, medication_id desc
mapper.delete: update cat_medication set del_flag = '2' where medication_id = #{medicationId}
mapper.update: update cat_medication m set m.del_flag = '2' where m.diagnosis_id = #{diagnosisId} and m.source_type = '2' and not exists ( select 1 from cat_medication_exec e where e.cat_id = m.cat_id and e.use_date = m.use_date and e.time_period = m.time_period and e.status = '1' )
mapper.select:
select m.cat_id, m.use_date, m.time_period, count(*) as drug_count, group_concat(m.drug_name order by m.medication_id separator '、') as drug_names, max(m.prescription_id) as prescription_id, max(e.status) as exec_status, max(e.executor) as executor, max(e.exec_time) as exec_time, max(e.photos) as photos, max(e.photo_time) as photo_time, max(e.adverse_reaction) as adverse_reaction, max(e.remark) as exec_remark, max(e.update_time) as exec_update_time from cat_medication m left join cat_medication_exec e on e.cat_id = m.cat_id and e.use_date = m.use_date and e.time_period = m.time_period
m.del_flag = '0' AND m.cat_id = #{catId}
AND m.cat_id IN (SELECT cat_id FROM cat_profile WHERE del_flag = '0' AND base_id = #{catBaseId}) AND m.cat_id IN (SELECT cat_id FROM cat_profile WHERE del_flag = '0' AND ward_id = #{catWardId})
AND m.cat_id IN ( SELECT p.cat_id FROM cat_profile p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.ward_id IN (SELECT a.ward_id FROM cat_ward_auth a WHERE a.user_id = #{assistantUserId}) )
AND m.time_period = #{timePeriod} AND m.use_date = #{useDate} AND m.use_date = #{useDateStr} AND date_format(m.use_date,'%y.%m.%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y.%m.%d') AND date_format(m.use_date,'%y.%m.%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y.%m.%d') AND m.source_type = #{sourceType} AND e.executor = #{executor}
AND e.status = '1' AND (e.status IS NULL OR e.status = '0')
group by m.cat_id, m.use_date, m.time_period order by m.use_date desc, m.cat_id desc, case m.time_period when '早' then 1 when '中' then 2 when '晚' then 3 else 9 end
mapper.update: update cat_medication m set m.del_flag = '2' where m.prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} and m.del_flag = '0' and m.use_date >= #{fromDate} and not exists ( select 1 from cat_medication_exec e where e.cat_id = m.cat_id and e.use_date = m.use_date and e.time_period = m.time_period and e.status = '1' )

update cat_medication m set m.del_flag = '2' where m.prescription_id = #{prescriptionId} and m.del_flag = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from cat_medication_exec e where e.cat_id = m.cat_id and e.use_date = m.use_date and e.time_period = m.time_period and e.status = '1' )
mapper.delete: update cat_medication set del_flag = '2' where medication_id in #{id}
